newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed steady at 42.70 to the dollar in the kerb market on Sunday amid a rise in demand for the U.S. currency and is likely to open steady on Tuesday, dealers said.
They said the dollar, which fell against the rupee during the past few days, attracted buying from local players while its supply dropped from abroad.

The State Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 rupees to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 6.70 percent compared to Sunday's 6.80 percent. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
